headline_seed: Canada's Carney launches a sovereign wealth fund. What is it?
description_seed: The fund - which Canadians can invest in directly - will help pay for major infrastructure projects in the country, the prime minister says.

what: Canada's Carney launches a sovereign wealth fund. What is it?

clean_source_blocks.text: To that end, today, Prime Minister Carney announced the Canada Strong Fund – Canada’s first national sovereign wealth fund. Through an initial federal contribution of $25 billion, the Fund will strategically invest, alongside the private sector, in Canadian projects and companies driving our economic transformation. This includes projects in clean and conventional energy, critical minerals, agriculture, and infrastructure.
The fund - which Canadians can invest in directly - will help pay for major infrastructure projects in the country, the prime minister says.

Prime Minister Mark Carney says Canada will launch its first ever national sovereign wealth fund, an investment account that he says will ensure all Canadians reap the rewards of government support for major new projects.
Canada is launching a government-owned investment fund to pay for major development projects in the country, Prime Minister Mark Carney has announced.
